newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro Pacific raises stock div to 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Metro Pacific raises stock div to 33 pct.

text.p: Philippine holding firm Metro Pacific Corp said on Wednesday its board had agreed to increase its stock dividend to 33 percent from the previous 30 percent.
The 30 percent stock dividend was declared on June 3.
The company did not give any reason for the increase.
The record date is yet to be fixed by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
A special stockholders' meeting has been set on July 4 for ratification.
